name: job-post-quality-chat
description: Review a job posting for clarity, required vs preferred criteria, and screening matrix. Emits job-post-quality-report. Not legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a pasted job description or draft.

inputs.name: job-description
inputs.description: Job posting or draft text to review.

inputs.name: role-level
inputs.description: Optional seniority or level for calibration.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: job-post-quality-report
outputs.description: Structured job post quality review; empty when JD is missing.
